button: Reinvent the wheel. Again. From scratch.
endings: You stand at the end of everything, holding a wheel. You realize you could do it better. You always could.
The multiverse is full of wheels. You look at one closely. Hm. Slightly lumpy. Back to the rocks.
A voice from the void asks: 'Haven't you done this already?' You pick up a rock anyway.
restarts: Reinvention #{n} begins. You pick up a rock. You have a feeling about this rock. Again.
Reinvention #{n}. The cave apprentices look at you with deep, ancestral weariness.
Reinvention #{n}. History is a flat circle. Which, notably, is a wheel.
